name: 3-Pack Tie-Dye Dark Gray Fluffy Soft Shag Runner Rugs (1m x 2m)
description: Add ultra-cozy comfort to your hallways, bedside, or study areas with this set of 3 fluffy shaggy runner rugs! Each rug measures approximately 1m x 2m (approx. 3.3ft x 6.6ft), featuring a modern tie-dye dark gray pattern that effectively hides dirt while looking sleek. Designed with a super-soft plush high-pile top layer, memory foam cushioning, and an anti-slip dotted backing. Note: This listing is for a total quantity of 3 matching runner rugs, priced at just $10 per unit! They have been thoroughly vacuumed, cleaned, and sanitized. Coming from a pet-friendly home with a resident cat, they have been meticulously processed, but please note they do NOT come with secondary retail storage bags; please bring your own hamper or bag for transport.
contact_note: Includes a total of 3 identical runner rugs. Does NOT come with additional storage bags; local buyers must bring their own hamper or bags for transport. Thoroughly cleaned, but comes from a cat-friendly student home.
meta_description: Shop a 3-pack of tie-dye dark gray fluffy soft shag runner rugs. Each 1m x 2m long carpet features non-slip backing, perfect for bedrooms or hallways.
name_zh: 3条合售 扎染深灰色加厚长毛绒廊道/床边走廊地毯 (1米*2米)
description_zh: 搬家清仓超值低价！一共3条同款扎染深灰色长条形长毛绒避尘地毯，每条尺寸均为标准 1米*2米（约3.3英尺*6.6英尺），现以每条 $10 的绝对极客清仓价转让（可单买或3条一起打包带走）。表面采用极度蓬松细腻的渐变丝绒，中间带舒适回弹的海绵夹层，底部带千个密集的点塑防滑防摔颗粒，抓地力极强。扎染深灰配色不仅百搭且极度耐脏，非常适合铺在走廊、玄关或床边。地毯已全面完成深层吸尘与杀菌清理。由于本人养猫，虽然上架前已经过彻底清洁，但衣物/织物类难免可能残留极轻微的微小毛发痕迹。请注意，本品不含原装零售收纳袋，同城自提的小伙伴请记得自行携带大打包袋或脏衣篮来装运哦！
